Title: New networking features available in most regions

Body.Content:
The new networking features that were announced at TechEd Europe 2014 are now generally available in all regions except China North and China East. These new networking features include:
  • Network security groups
  • Forced tunneling
  • Multiple network adapter support for selected virtual machine sizes
  • High-performance VPN gateway size
  • Source IP affinity
  • Advanced Virtual Network Gateway policies for virtual networks
